## Load Libraries

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| message: false


library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: data
#| message: false

biopsy <- read_csv("https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv")
```

## Look at the data in PC coordinates

```{r}
#| label: look at data

#add PCA with prcomp() 
pca_fit <- biopsy |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> #select numeric variables for PCA
  scale() |> 
  prcomp() #do PCA

#The first principal component (PC1) captures the greatest possible variation in the data. The second (PC2) captures the greatest remaining variation, subject to being uncorrelated with PC1.


#make ggplot for PCA
pca_fit |> 
  augment(biopsy) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1,
             y = .fittedPC2,
             color = outcome)) +
  geom_point(size = 1,
             alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(malignant = "red2", 
                                benign = "green3")) +
  labs(title = "PC1 vs. PC2") +
  theme_light()

```
